import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.LocalizationCocycle
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SectionsAlgebra

open AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

universe u

set_option autoImplicit false

section
variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
variable (r : ι → Γ(X, ⊤))

-- probe 1: do the family instances synthesize?
example (i : ι) : IsLocalization.Away (r i) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r i)) := inferInstance
example (i j : ι) :
    IsLocalization.Away (r i * r j) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r i * r j)) := inferInstance
example (i : ι) : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r i)) := inferInstance

-- probe 2: does `diag` elaborate with named family arguments?
noncomputable example (i : ι) :
    Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r i * r i)) →ₐ[Γ(X, ⊤)] Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r i)) :=
  IsLocalization.AwayCover.diag (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := r)
    (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r i)))
    (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r i * r j))) i

end

-- probe 3: same, but with the families coming from structure projections
structure Pack (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type (u + 1) where
  ι : Type u
  [fintype : Fintype ι]
  [decEq : DecidableEq ι]
  r : ι → Γ(X, ⊤)

attribute [instance] Pack.fintype Pack.decEq

noncomputable example {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (P : Pack X) (i : P.ι) :
    Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r i)) →ₐ[Γ(X, ⊤)] Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)) :=
  IsLocalization.AwayCover.diag (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
    (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
    (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j))) i

-- probe 4: the equality form used in `diag_eq_basicRes`
example {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (P : Pack X) (i : P.ι) :
    IsLocalization.AwayCover.diag (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
        (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
        (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j))) i
      = X.basicRes _ _
          (le_of_le_of_eq (le_inf le_rfl le_rfl) (X.basicOpen_mul (P.r i) (P.r i)).symm) :=
  X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _

-- probe 5: full replica of `BasicRefinement` and the failing lemma, in-namespace
namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

open TopologicalSpace in
structure PointedCover.BasicRefinement' {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) :
    Type (u + 1) where
  ι : Type u
  [fintype : Fintype ι]
  [decEq : DecidableEq ι]
  pt : ι → X
  r : ι → Γ(X, ⊤)
  basicOpen_le : ∀ i, X.basicOpen (r i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (pt i)
  iSup_eq : (⨆ i, X.basicOpen (r i)) = ⊤

attribute [instance] PointedCover.BasicRefinement'.fintype PointedCover.BasicRefinement'.decEq

example {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] {𝒰 : X.PointedCover}
    (P : PointedCover.BasicRefinement' 𝒰) (i : P.ι) :
    IsLocalization.AwayCover.diag (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
        (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
        (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j))) i
      = X.basicRes _ _
          (le_of_le_of_eq (le_inf le_rfl le_rfl) (X.basicOpen_mul (P.r i) (P.r i)).symm) :=
  X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
